merged.world: A travel logistics agency evaluates service providers, transit operators, and hospitality partners for contract eligibility.

E1.text: Apex Tours maintains a fleet size of 20 vehicles.

E2.text: Apex Tours recorded a customer satisfaction rating of 92 percent.

E3.text: Apex Tours holds an active ISO 9001 quality certificate.

E4.text: Apex Tours maintains corporate liability coverage of 10,000,000 USD.

E5.text: Apex Tours maintains an average response time of 20 minutes.

E6.text: Blue Sky Aviation maintains an operational safety rating of 95 points.

E7.text: Crestview Bus Line holds an international transit operator licence.

E8.text: Driftwood Resort maintains a dedicated guest shuttle fleet of 8 vans.

B1.text: Apex Tours holds preferred logistics vendor classification.

B2.text: Apex Tours qualifies as a primary transit provider.

D1.text: Apex Tours is awarded the regional transport agreement.

B3.text: Blue Sky Aviation is accredited as a flight partner.

B4.text: Crestview Bus Line maintains cross-border routing authorization.

B5.text: Driftwood Resort qualifies for premium hospitality transport listing.

U1.text: An updated audit confirms Apex Tours maintains a customer satisfaction rating of 84 percent.

policies.B1: Preferred logistics status is attained either through a customer satisfaction rating of 90 percent or higher alongside a vehicle fleet of at least 15 units, or by holding an active ISO 9001 quality certificate.
policies.B2: An enterprise achieves primary transit vendor recognition if it possesses preferred logistics status while maintaining corporate liability coverage of at least 5,000,000 USD.
policies.D1: An entity secures a regional transport contract when it has primary transit vendor recognition and maintains an average response time of 30 minutes or less.
policies.B3: An aviation operator attains approved flight partner status provided its operational safety rating is at least 90 points.
policies.B4: Cross-border transit clearance is awarded to any bus operator holding an international transit operator licence.
policies.B5: A hospitality venue receives premium shuttle service classification if it maintains a dedicated guest shuttle fleet of at least 5 vans.

decoy_policies: A maritime carrier receives deep-water docking rights if it maintains a fleet size of at least 10 vessels and possesses a harbor safety permit.
An air cargo warehouse earns rapid clearance status when its annual storage capacity exceeds 50,000 metric tons.

B1: Apex Tours satisfies the requirement by having a customer satisfaction rating of 92 percent (at least 90 percent) and a fleet size of 20 vehicles (at least 15 vehicles).
Apex Tours satisfies the requirement by holding an active ISO 9001 quality certificate.
B2: Apex Tours satisfies the requirement by achieving preferred logistics status and holding corporate liability coverage of 10,000,000 USD (at least 5,000,000 USD).
D1: Apex Tours satisfies the requirement by achieving primary transit vendor recognition and maintaining an average response time of 20 minutes (at most 30 minutes).
B3: Blue Sky Aviation satisfies the requirement by maintaining an operational safety rating of 95 points (at least 90 points).
B4: Crestview Bus Line satisfies the requirement by holding an international transit operator licence.
B5: Driftwood Resort satisfies the requirement by maintaining a dedicated guest shuttle fleet of 8 vans (at least 5 vans).
